new_results.statement: For a physical original-coordinate bipartition with arbitrary same-side measurable terms and cross block B of rank r>=3, the law has a continuous density bounded by [2r/(r-2)]*(product of all nonzero singular values of B)^(-1/r).

For exact rank-three A=U Lambda U^T with max physical row leverage delta<(1-1/sqrt(2))^2, density is continuous and bounded by 6/eta*|det Lambda|^(-1/3), eta=1-(1/sqrt(2)+sqrt(delta))^2; at delta<=1/32, 192/7*|det Lambda|^(-1/3).

Combining the cross-block theorem with account04/B18 r1: a nonzero scalar pivot whose Schur residual cross block has rank r>=3 satisfies density cap 2*sqrt([2r/(r-2)]/(|a|*(product sigma)^(1/r))), with arbitrary residual diagonal blocks.
